main_text.p: ciorum ratione fraudem ijs non facerent: quaterni ex tribus agri partibus praetores cum quatuor Drentinis, quatuor confulibus Groninganis, duobus item antistitibus Adoardiano & Werumano, quotannis Groningae in curia convenirent, & monetam examinarent, remq; numariam ex commodo totius regionis constituerent. Pronunciatum prid. Petri & Pauli Apostolorum anno M. CCC. XXXVIII[?], sed sigillis tribus tantum signatum, Fivelingio, Hunesgonio, Drentino; reliquis, quibus signari debuerat, Groningano, Fredowoldio, Langowoldio, Hummerzio, Octopagico, non adjectis. Unde suspicio mihi est, conditiones illas duriores recusasse civitatem. Nec tamen eâ minus pax coiit. Ab annis deinde non multis arx[?] Selwerdia bono Reip. à Groninganis, Hunesgoniis, Fivelgoniis, Langowoldiis pecuniâ publicâ empta est, & solo aequata: pecuniaque in hunc usum à sociis omnibus collata. Periculosa quippe arcis ejus firmitas non solum urbi, sed caeteris quoque de libertate suâ sollicitis videbatur. Et cum pecuniae ejus gratiâ controversia inter ur-banos

page.notes: The first part of the page is set in italic, and the sentence runs over from the previous page. "irx" in "irx Selwerdia" is doubtful; it is probably "arx". The numeral "xxxviii" is printed with broken letters and is copied as read. The printed "ijs" and "Hunesgonio" are kept as printed. The catchword "banos" and signature "E 5" are at the foot. The scan has a Google watermark at the bottom right, which is left out.
